mapper.select: SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, COALESCE(pending.pending_approval_id, appr.route_approval_id) AS electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(pending.pending_ea_exe_id, appr.route_ea_exe_id, '') AS ea_exe_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pending.pending_title), ''), '') AS title, t.tenant_code, g.cata_code, g.cata_name AS category_name, COALESCE(g.view_seq, 0) AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term, COALESCE(pending.pending_drafter_name, pending.pending_login_code, CAST(pending.pending_login_id AS varchar), '-') AS created_by, CONCAT('검토:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '-'), ' / 승인:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '-')) AS owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS todo_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 'in_progress' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 'approved' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN 'pre_apply' ELSE 'pre_apply' END AS approval_status_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN '결재중' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN '승인' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN '임시저장' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN '반송' ELSE '미완료' END AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(pending.pending_arrival_at, appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at, CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) AS template_json, w.drafting_work_template_html AS template_html, CASE WHEN w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.total_count, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS written_in_cycle, COALESCE(pending.pending_alert, FALSE) AS pending_approval_alert, TO_CHAR(pending.pending_arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS pending_arrival_at FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ru.login_id = w.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND au.login_id = w.approver_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.electronic_approval_id AS pending_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') AS pending_ea_exe_id, m.ea_title AS pending_title, m.login_id AS pending_login_id, la.login_code AS pending_login_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar)) AS pending_drafter_name, MAX(li.arrival_at) AS pending_arrival_at, TRUE AS pending_alert FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info li ON li.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND li.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id LEFT JOIN tb_user pu ON pu.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND pu.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_id = m.login_id WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND li.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND li.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND li.exe_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' GROUP BY m.electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, ''), m.ea_title, m.login_id, la.login_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar)) ORDER BY MAX(li.arrival_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pending ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( WITH cycle_base AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('월', '매월', 'month', 'MONTH', 'monthly', 'MONTHLY') THEN date_trunc('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('주', '매주', 'week', 'WEEK', 'weekly', 'WEEKLY') THEN date_trunc('week', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE date_trunc('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) END AS cycle_start ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_apply_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, MAX(COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at, ( ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(m.status_type, '') ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS latest_status_type, ( ARRAY_AGG(m.electronic_approval_id ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS route_approval_id ,( ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS route_ea_exe_id FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m CROSS JOIN cycle_base cb WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND (#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR m.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) >= cb.cycle_start ) appr ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ) AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at) DESC, w.drafting_work_category_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_todo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS draft_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS today_action_count, 0::int AS notice_count FROM tb_drafting_work_category w LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) appr ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ) AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) )

SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, m.electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') AS ea_exe_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(m.ea_title), ''), '') AS title, t.tenant_code, g.cata_code, g.cata_name AS category_name, COALESCE(g.view_seq, 0) AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar), '-') AS created_by, CONCAT('검토:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ru.user_nm), ''), '-'), ' / 승인:', COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(au.user_nm), ''), '-')) AS owner, 'IN_PROGRESS' AS todo_status, 'in_progress' AS approval_status_type, '결재중' AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(li.arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at, CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) AS template_json, w.drafting_work_template_html AS template_html, CASE WHEN w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, TRUE AS written_in_cycle, TRUE AS pending_approval_alert, TO_CHAR(li.arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS pending_arrival_at FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info li JOIN tb_electronic_approval_main m ON m.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND m.electronic_approval_id = li.electronic_approval_id JOIN tb_drafting_work_category w ON w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND w.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ru.login_id = w.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND au.login_id = w.approver_id LEFT JOIN tb_user pu ON pu.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND pu.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_id = m.login_id WHERE w.tenant_id = ( SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{tenantCode} LIMIT 1 ) AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND li.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND li.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND li.exe_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ORDER BY li.arrival_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC

SELECT 1::bigint AS notice_id, '업체'::varchar AS scope, 'HACCP CCP 온도기록 누락 점검 주간 운영(6.19~6.26)'::varchar AS title, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS notice_date UNION ALL SELECT 2::bigint, '업체'::varchar, '현장 점검 체크리스트 모바일 입력 기능 점검 안내'::varchar, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day', 'YYYY-MM-DD') UNION ALL SELECT 3::bigint, '플랫폼'::varchar, '플랫폼 공통 문서 템플릿 버전관리 정책 업데이트 안내'::varchar, TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 day', 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY notice_id ASC
